## 赛道关键帧（Qwen Image 2.1 文生图）

每一行是一张关键帧。点一次 **运行** 生成全部 2 张，共消耗 2 个额度（30 步 = 1 个额度）。

图片保存在 `output/dream7/`，文件名形如 `K0_00001_.png`，每重新生成一次编号加 1。

**生成后对照分镜检查**：前方的路往哪边弯、离弯道多远，画面里该有的东西在不在。不对就改这张图提示词开头的场景描述（`Photorealistic onboard` 之前的部分），再点运行：ComfyUI 只会重新生成提示词改过的那张。节点没有随机种子，提示词不变时重新生成也是同一张图。

ComfyUI 重启后缓存会清空，点运行会把每张都重新生成；只想重做一张时，先选中其他行的 Save Image 节点，按 Ctrl+M 静音。

**定稿后复制到 input 目录**（镜头工作流会读取这些文件名）：

```
cp output/dream7/K0_00001_.png input/dream7_K0.png
```

The car is stationary on the starting grid, sitting exactly on the chequered start/finish line painted across a long, wide straight. A start light gantry with five red lights spans the track overhead ahead. On the right side a large covered grandstand packed with spectators and a pit building with a pit wall. A red race car waits on the grid a few metres ahead, slightly to the right. The straight runs far ahead to the vanishing point, slightly downhill. Photorealistic onboard racing footage filmed by a T-cam mounted just above and behind the driver's helmet of a dark-blue open-wheel single-seater race car with a white nose. Only the halo safety bar, the top of the cockpit and the front wing tips are visible at the bottom of the frame; the camera height and framing never change. Sunny afternoon, clear blue sky, warm consistent sunlight. Grey asphalt circuit with white edge lines, red-and-white striped kerbs on every corner, green grass run-off, blue barrier walls, rolling green hills and scattered trees in the distance. Cinematic, sharp, natural colours, 16:9. No on-screen text, no logos, no watermark.

Travelling at about 320 km/h at the far end of a long straight, strong motion blur on the verges. Three white braking marker boards stand on the right verge. Just ahead the track turns sharply LEFT into a tight hairpin with a red-and-white kerb on the inside left. The red race car is directly ahead, slightly to the right, a few car lengths away.
